title: Consistent Modified Gravity Weak Lensing in Energy-Flow Cosmology: The µ–Σ Eigenmode, Destructive Interference, and E_G as the Orthogonal Probe
description: Derives the observable eigenstructure of EFC in weak lensing (Case B). Shows that µ(k,z) in the growth ODE and Σ(k,z) in the lensing kernel produce destructive interference, with growth suppression cancelling 66% of lensing amplification. Weak lensing constrains only one effective parameter η_eff = 0.017. Proves E_G is the orthogonal probe that breaks the µ–Σ degeneracy, predicting E_G^EFC/E_G^GR = 1.086.
